1. Main System Components

a. Frontend Layer (from apps/OpenSign):
- React-based web application
- User interface components (src/components)
- State management (Redux store)
- Internationalization support (i18n)

b. Backend Layer (from apps/OpenSignServer):
- Parse Server implementation
- Custom routes and API endpoints

c. Storage Layer:
- MongoDB database

- S3-compatible storage

Draw the following interaction flows:

```
User Upload → PDF Processing → Signature Placement → Document Storage → Email Notifications

```

c. Document Signing Flow:
```
Signer Access → Verification → Document Retrieval → Signature Application → Audit Trail
```
